title: UPPER applies simple single-codepoint Unicode case mapping without expanding ß/ﬀ or applying Turkish dotted-I rules
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088 and 16.0.19822, UPPER performs single-codepoint BMP case mapping without full Unicode SpecialCasing expansions or NFC normalization: "straße" becomes "STRAßE" (not "STRASSE"), "ﬀoo" remains "ﬀOO", "Istanbul" becomes "ISTANBUL" (not Turkish dotted İ), dotless "ı" becomes "I", Greek final "ς" becomes "Σ", and Deseret U+10428 ("𐐨") above U+FFFF is unchanged. In compatibility version 1, @UNICHAR(454) returns #NAME? (pre-2013 function prefix) whereas compatibility version 2 supports it.
basis: Measured across dcfl2_text (row 46), f2_rows (row 16), jnt_text_formats (rows 99-100) in Excel 16.0.20527.20088, docs/research/text-casing-2026-05-20.md in Excel 16.0.19822, and fn1_excel_case_mapping_controls, and matched across 2,114/2,114 full-bank UPPER rows.
